rubric_hint.rule: 2 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Completed felling overlaps only 0.045 ha (1.9%) of the polygon, from 2010 fellings. This is far below the 50% threshold for ALREADY_FELLED.

Two eligible VU site-bound species were recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m: the fungus Hydnellum scabrosum (906 m, 2026) and the lichen Alectoria sarmentosa (943 m, 2 records, 2026). Both list lack of continuity forest and lack of large or old trees among their threats. Coordinate uncertainty is 25 m.

Supporting context: two site-bound forest NT species (Carbonicola myrmecina, Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum) were recorded 912-953 m away. The mobile NT birds Picoides tridactylus and Poecile montanus are supporting evidence only. Fewer than 3 site-bound NT species are within 250 m.
Near-site effort is zero records inside the polygon and within 250 m. Effort within 1000 m is far below the county median (10 records vs 66, 16th percentile, 1 observation day).

uncertainties: All records within 1000 m come from a single observation day, so they may reflect where one observer went rather than where species are.
The eligible species are 906 m or more from the polygon edge, so they may not occur on the site.
The records are all from 2026, which is recent, but they say nothing about the stand itself.
not_established: That the threatened species occur on the felling site.
That the stand has old-forest or continuity-forest features.
That the lack of records within 250 m means anything, since effort there is zero.
next_action: Have a reviewer check the stand for habitat of the nearby VU fungus and lichen and for old-forest features. A field inventory would help, since the site is poorly surveyed.
